description: Choose a physical DeepRacer model archive (.tar.gz) to upload from your local file system. The archive must contain a trained model exported from the AWS DeepRacer console or a compatible training environment.

modelInfo.fileDescription: Select a .tar.gz archive containing the trained model (model.pb and model_metadata.json).
